capabilities: answer natural-language questions grounded in retrieved note context
run semantic search over the vault by meaning rather than keywords
chunk and embed Markdown notes into a local incremental vector index
cite and link the source notes used in each answer
add specific notes to the chat prompt via a note picker
extras: Desktop-only; does not work on Obsidian mobile. Full documentation lives on a separate site (artemiadze.github.io/prometheus). Requires installing Ollama and downloading models before use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in natural-language question answering or meaning-based search, and most AI plugins rely on cloud APIs that would expose note contents.

relations.evidence: sends that context to a local LLM via Ollama

summary: Local-first AI assistant that runs semantic search over the vault and answers questions from retrieved notes via a local Ollama LLM, with cited sources.
